name: swarfkit
description: Find and reclaim the disk space left behind by agent-driven development.
author: Sundar Shahi Thakuri

scripts.build:node: bun build src/index.ts --target=node --outfile dist/swarf.js && node -e "const f='dist/swarf.js';let s=require('fs').readFileSync(f,'utf8');s=s.replace(/^#!.*\n/,'#!/usr/bin/env node\n');require('fs').writeFileSync(f,s);require('fs').chmodSync(f,0o755)"
scripts.build: bun run build:node && bun run build:macos-arm && bun run build:macos-x64 && bun run build:linux-x64
